settings.title: Local MQTT
settings.intro: The local Glow meter devices read your Glow display's MQTT feed through the connection set up below. Nothing runs, and no port is opened, until you add a local device or press Start now.
settings.requireAuthHint: When this is on, clients with these credentials can also subscribe, for example with mosquitto_sub. When it's off, no client can subscribe.
settings.prefixHint: Must match the topic prefix set on the display. The display's default is glow.
settings.connectionTitle: What to enter on the display
settings.connectionSteps: On the display, open Settings → Metering → MQTT and enter these. The display needs firmware 1.8.12 or later. An Ethernet CAD without a screen is set up at managecads.glowmarkt.com instead.
settings.fixedAddressNote: The display needs an IP address, not a name. Give Homey a fixed address (a DHCP reservation in your router) or the feed will stop if its address changes.
settings.startNowHint: With no local devices, the MQTT connection runs only while you need it, for example to check the display is sending.
settings.noUnits: No display has sent anything yet.
settings.skippedEntries: Left out at the last pairing

skipReason.no_electricity: it has no electricity consumption resource

settings.debugHint: The last 50 messages, newest first. MPAN, MPRN, EUI and supplier are masked to their last four characters.

invalid.credentials: Enter a username and password, or press Regenerate.

errors.port_in_use: Port __port__ is already in use by another app; choose another port.

cloud.accessRefused: Glowmarkt is refusing access to this meter (HTTP 401), even after logging in again. Trying again every hour.

gasmeter.title: Add a Glow gas meter
gasmeter.waiting: Waiting for a gas reading from your display. Set up MQTT on the display; this page checks every 2 seconds and moves on as soon as a reading arrives.
gasmeter.allPaired: Every display that's sending gas readings already has a Glow gas meter device.

electricitymeter.title: Add a Glow electricity meter
electricitymeter.waiting: Waiting for an electricity reading from your display. Set up MQTT on the display; this page checks every 2 seconds and moves on as soon as a reading arrives.
electricitymeter.allPaired: Every display that's sending electricity readings already has a Glow electricity meter device.

pair.steps: On the display, open Settings → Metering → MQTT and enter these details. The display needs firmware 1.8.12 or later. An Ethernet CAD without a screen is set up at managecads.glowmarkt.com instead.
pair.externalNote: The app is set to use an external broker, so point the display at that broker, using its IP address rather than a name. You can change this in the app's settings.
pair.layerError: The MQTT connection isn't running: __message__ Check the app's settings.
pair.noGasVolume: No gas volume reported, so this device can't feed Homey Energy
pair.energyNote: This device registers in Homey Energy as a whole-home electricity meter. If you already have one, such as a P1 meter or an inverter's meter, exclude one of them in Energy so your usage isn't counted twice.

device.stale: No data from the display for __minutes__ minutes
device.noGasVolume: Your display isn't reporting gas volume, so this device can't feed Homey Energy.
